## Detailed Findings

#### 1. MCP v2 upgrade (mcp, ~5h, HIGH)

- **What**: OpenCode #39247 upgrades MCP client SDK from v1.29.0 to
  v2.0.0-beta.5. Replaces `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0` and its
  local patch with `@modelcontextprotocol/client@2.0.0-beta.5`, negotiates
  modern stateless and legacy MCP servers, delegates pagination to SDK v2,
  supports modern list-change subscriptions (tools/resources/prompts
  change notifications), migrates OAuth issuer stamping and callback
  handling, updates `mcp debug` command to use v2 client, regenerates the
  JavaScript SDK bindings, and migrates existing MCP fixtures and tests
  to the v2 client/server packages. Intentionally deferred: legacy
  session-expiry HTTP 404 reconnect/retry, OAuth discovery-state
  persistence, new conformance and protocol-era test infrastructure. 131
  tests pass, 1 intentionally skipped session-recovery test, 0 fail.
- **Why**: Alexi uses `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@^1.29.0` (v1). MCP v2
  brings modern stateless protocol support (no session ID, better
  reconnect semantics), improved pagination delegation, and list-change
  subscriptions (dynamic tool/resource updates without polling). OpenCode's
  migration path is clean: replace SDK package, negotiate modern/legacy
  servers transparently, migrate OAuth handling, update MCP commands,
  regenerate SDK bindings, migrate tests. Alexi's MCP integration
  (`src/mcp/client.ts`, `src/mcp/server.ts`) would benefit from modern
  stateless protocol and list-change subscriptions (dynamic MCP server
  tool discovery). Size: HIGH (~5h: replace SDK package in package.json,
  migrate client initialization in `src/mcp/client.ts`, adapt OAuth
  handling if present, update MCP commands, regenerate SDK bindings if
  applicable, migrate tests in `tests/mcp/` or `src/mcp/`, verify modern/
  legacy negotiation). Portable (TypeScript, SDK package upgrade, client
  API migration).
- **Source**: OpenCode PR #39247 "feat(mcp): upgrade client SDK to v2"
  (merged 2026-07-28T04:19:34Z, commit `921b1c6`). Full PR body at
  https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/39247. Co-authored by Matt Carey.
- **Category**: mcp. **Size**: HIGH (~5h: replace SDK package, migrate
  client initialization, adapt OAuth handling, update MCP commands,
  regenerate SDK bindings, migrate tests). **Status**: HIGH signal
  (MCP v2 brings modern stateless protocol, improved pagination, list-
  change subscriptions; Alexi uses v1; clean migration path in OpenCode
  #39247).

#### 2. Connector session persistence (core, ~6h, HIGH)

- **What**: Cline #12125 persists and restores connector sessions across
  CLI daemon or hub restarts. Successful detached connector runs record
  reconnect args (stripping interactive flags) in SQLite; stops and
  explicit stop-all disable autostart; dashboard config is stored
  separately from CLI-only connection state, with `mergeConnectorConnectArgs`
  refreshing managed flags without wiping CLI runtime options. The CLI
  connect layer gains `runConnectAdapter` persistence via
  `ConnectRunContext`, per-instance `stopInstance`, `validate` before
  restart, and `runRestartConnector` with validate → stop (preserve
  autostart) → start → rollback to `lastSuccessfulArgs` on failure.
  Background launches now poll until the child is ready (or fail/timeout)
  and use `CONNECT_ALREADY_RUNNING_EXIT_CODE` so persistence is not
  rewritten when an instance is already up. `connect --restart` /
  `--restart-instance` are wired in `main.ts`. Hub and desktop hosts
  register `setConnectorCliLaunchSpec` at startup, pass it into the
  detached daemon env, and after `hubDaemonReady` call
  `reconnectDaemonConnectors` to spawn `cline connect` (using
  `--restart-instance` for survivors). Hub/desktop connector UIs use
  shared `buildConnectorConnectArgs` and atomic `--restart` instead of
  stop-then-start; `listActiveConnectors` lives in core and is exported
  from `@cline/core`. Adapters implement `stopInstance`, optional
  `validateOptions`, and set persistence instance IDs/args (Telegram
  validates token before "already running" and persists resolved
  `--bot-username`).
- **Why**: Alexi has no connector/adapter system (no Telegram, Slack,
  external-process adapters). However, the architecture is portable
  (TypeScript, SQLite persistence, validate-restart-rollback pattern,
  background process lifecycle). Applicable if Alexi implements external
  integrations (MCP servers that need reconnect on daemon restart,
  webhooks, persistent background services like file watchers). Validate-
  restart-rollback pattern is a best practice for any persistent background
  service (validate options before start, stop preserving autostart, start,
  rollback to last-known-good on failure). Size: HIGH (~6h: design
  persistence schema in SQLite or JSON, implement validate-restart-
  rollback pattern, add autostart/reconnect logic, wire into session
  lifecycle, test rollback edge cases, handle concurrent restarts).
  Portable (TypeScript, persistence, background process lifecycle).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12125 "feat(core): persist and restore connector
  sessions" (merged 2026-07-27T22:59:24Z, commit `51e5daf`). Full PR body
  at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/12125. Reviewed by Cursor Bugbot.
- **Category**: core. **Size**: HIGH (~6h: design persistence schema,
  implement validate-restart-rollback pattern, add autostart/reconnect
  logic, wire into session lifecycle, test rollback edge cases). **Status**:
  HIGH signal (connector persistence architecture is portable; applicable
  if Alexi implements external integrations or persistent background
  services; validate-restart-rollback is best practice for background
  services).

#### 3. Free-model rate-limit UX (provider, ~3h, HIGH)

- **What**: Cline #12593 adds free-model rate-limit UX. Free models have
  ID prefix `cline-free` and show `(free)` label in model names. Free-
  limit errors surface reset time in error message. VS Code adds a model-
  switch button on limit error. CLI shows limit-reached message with reset
  timestamp and pricing table. Model pricing set to 0 for free models.
  Includes free-limit error handling, model-not-found error, and model-
  promotion-ended state.
- **Why**: Alexi uses SAP AI Core (no free tier, no rate-limit UX for
  free models). The feature is provider-tier UX (graceful degradation on
  rate limit, switch-model escape hatch, reset timestamp transparency).
  Size: HIGH (~3h: detect rate-limit error codes from provider responses,
  surface reset timestamp in error message, render model-switch UI in
  Ink TUI, show limit-reached message with reset time, add model-tier
  metadata to model catalog). Applicable if Alexi adds free-tier provider
  routing (e.g., community-model proxies with rate limits, SAP AI Core
  free tier if introduced, fallback to free models on budget exhaustion).
  Portable (TypeScript, error-code detection, TUI rendering, provider
  metadata).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12593 "Cline free ux" (merged 2026-07-28T04:20:28Z,
  commit `dc175c7`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/
  12593. Follow-up to #12591.
- **Category**: provider. **Size**: HIGH (~3h: detect rate-limit error
  codes, surface reset timestamp, render model-switch UI in TUI, show
  limit-reached message, add model-tier metadata). **Status**: HIGH signal
  (provider-tier UX for graceful degradation on rate limits; applicable
  if Alexi adds free-tier provider routing or community-model proxies with
  rate limits).
